item.title: Slight edit to addendum
item.content:encoded: Watching people's reactions, aside from folks who would just find the premise silly however it was written, it seems that there were some tone issues that were helping that impression along unnecessarily. So I did some tweaks to help the tone out a little bit. Mrs. ███████'s voice and backstory are really irrelevant. The important part is that these things can implant themselves into you. Explicitly mentioning vagina dentata was really superfluous, by the time a reader reaches the word "brothel" they know very well what's going on. So I went and redacted those bits…
